headline: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks; Democrats flip Texas high courts; EU hits Russian banks

austin.headline: Leadership shift revives hopes for Austin's delayed light rail
austin.summary: A taxpayer lawsuit over Project Connect's bonds is on appeal, and the incoming Democratic attorney general says he is reviewing the case before 2027 construction.

austin.headline: Austin musicians stick with tape and real instruments over AI
austin.summary: Local artists and a Buda studio owner describe recording with analog gear and keeping AI out of their work.

texas.headline: Democrats flip Texas Supreme Court and criminal appeals seats
texas.summary: Voters gave Democrats four Supreme Court seats, including the chief justice's, three Court of Criminal Appeals seats and control of the 15th Court of Appeals.

texas.headline: Paxton's office drops bid to ban CAIR in Texas
texas.summary: The attorney general's office ended its lawsuit seeking to declare the Muslim civil rights group a terrorist organization.

texas.headline: Voter-approved $3 billion dementia fund still stuck in court
texas.summary: A year after passage, the dementia research institute remains idle over a lawsuit about vote-counting machines, and a GOP lawmaker has filed a repeal bill.

texas.headline: Texas local governments forgo more than $1 billion for data centers
texas.summary: The Tribune tallies property tax breaks granted by local governments to data center projects.

texas.headline: How Texas cannabis policy could change in 2027
texas.summary: New Democratic statewide officials could revisit hemp rules and enforcement, though a Republican Senate remains the main obstacle to legalization bills.

us.headline: Appeals court weighs moving Trump's hush money case to federal court
us.summary: A 2nd Circuit panel questioned both sides at length on Trump's bid to erase the conviction but did not rule.

us.headline: Van Hollen says he can beat Schumer for Senate Democratic leader
us.summary: The Maryland senator is making his case to colleagues in the leadership race.

us.headline: Judge sets March retrial for Lindsay Clancy
us.summary: A Massachusetts judge scheduled a new trial for the mother charged in the deaths of her three children.

us.headline: United says it fixed a technology issue that delayed departures
us.summary: The airline reported resolving a systems problem that held up outbound flights days after the nationwide ground stop.

australia.headline: Australia joins US-led pact on AI supply chains
australia.summary: Australia signed a 10-nation declaration to protect critical minerals, energy, data centres and sensitive AI technology as Albanese attended ASEAN talks in Manila.

australia.headline: Government reverses course on backpacker visa rules
australia.summary: The third-year working holiday cap rises from 5,000 to 25,000 places, the ballot is delayed, and second-year applicants will need more regional work days.

australia.headline: Chalmers proposes letting super funds invest more in housing and energy
australia.summary: The treasurer outlined rule changes to widen superannuation investment in housing, energy and startups.

australia.headline: Victorian leaders face off as early voting nears
australia.summary: Labor, Liberal, Greens and One Nation leaders debated ahead of the November 28 state election, with early voting opening Wednesday.

australia.headline: Armed clashes reported in remote NT community
australia.summary: Up to 100 people armed with axes, spears and crossbows were reported fighting in the Northern Territory's remote west.

ai.headline: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
ai.summary: The state attorney general filed suit tied to a Hugging Face hacking incident and the risk of losing control of AI models.

ai.headline: Trump says he is fine with Huang returning as Nvidia CEO
ai.summary: The president said he sees no national security risk in Jensen Huang's possible return.

ai.headline: OpenAI signs up four independent safety evaluators
ai.summary: The company announced agreements with outside groups to test its models.

ai.headline: Altimeter plans a $5 billion order in Anthropic's IPO
ai.summary: Brad Gerstner's firm says it is putting in for $5 billion of shares in the upcoming listing.

ai.headline: UN talks aim to curb autonomous weapons
ai.summary: Negotiators are discussing limits on so-called killer robots amid growing concern over AI-driven drones.

tech.headline: Chase glitch disrupts online banking at major US banks
tech.summary: Customers reported problems at several big banks; Chase blamed a technical bug, not a cyberattack, and said funds remained accessible.

tech.headline: US moves to close loophole giving China access to advanced chips
tech.summary: Officials are working to shut a route that let Chinese firms obtain advanced AI chips.

world.headline: EU accuses Russia of stalling talks while hitting power plants
world.summary: EU foreign ministers sanctioned nearly 50 Russian banks and financial firms and said a ceasefire must come first.

world.headline: At least 17 killed in two South African mass shootings
world.summary: Eight people were found dead near Pietermaritzburg and nine near Pretoria on Sunday; police have not established motives.

world.headline: Le Pen says France would end financial aid to Kyiv under her
world.summary: The National Rally leader said she would halt new French financial support for Ukraine if elected in 2027 while honouring existing commitments.

world.headline: Romania, Estonia and Sweden urge united EU response to Russian attacks
world.summary: The ministers cited drone strikes on ships near Romania's Sulina Canal and an alleged GRU sabotage attempt in Estonia.

world.headline: Pope wraps up South America trip in Peru
world.summary: The pontiff left Peru at the end of a lengthy tour of the region.

aus-cricket.headline: Stars storm back to beat Thunder in WBBL
aus-cricket.summary: Defending 120, the Melbourne Stars took the Thunder's last seven wickets for 26 to win by six runs, with Georgia Prestwidge taking 5-25.

aus-cricket.headline: Ecclestone ruled out of WBBL|12 in blow to Strikers
aus-cricket.summary: England spinner Sophie Ecclestone will miss the rest of the season with a back injury.

aus-cricket.headline: Nine-month wait poses World Cup selection puzzle for Australia
aus-cricket.summary: ABC Sport looks at the long gap before Australia's next Cricket World Cup assignment.

warriors.headline: Warriors lose 115-94 at New Orleans for third straight defeat
warriors.summary: Yaxel Lendeborg scored 28 but Golden State fell to 8-6 as Jeremiah Fears posted a triple-double for the Pelicans.

warriors.headline: Curry and Williams still sidelined; Warriors at Dallas Wednesday
warriors.summary: Stephen Curry (oblique) and Brandon Williams (hamstring) sat again; Golden State visits the Mavericks at 5 p.m. PT Wednesday, then Memphis Thursday.
